calls.summary:
# Nhat vs Johnny
Date: 2026-10-23 | Duration: 21m

## Summary
The discussion focused on aligning AI-assistant configuration and related screens with the intended design while preserving existing functionality. Model-selector placement, provider-session duplication, and enterprise-only visibility require information-architecture review. Cleanup includes correcting spacing, centering, line height, table widths, refresh-button placement, enterprise matching, and long-log readability. A full-width modal or side panel was favored for opening logs without losing the underlying page. Legacy owner-field behavior, navigation animation, automatic submenu collapse, and profile-dropdown controls will remain, while side highlighting will be removed and collapsed-menu patterns reviewed. Password reset placement will move toward Settings. Remaining design gaps include missing tags, custom-field and custom-mark areas, inconsistent add-row typography, search-control alignment, and the keyboard shortcut. Nhat Ho owns implementation cleanup, while Johnny Martinez handles design clarification, tags investigation, Markdown styling, screenshots, and collapsed-navigation direction. Demo readiness depends on completing the parity work.

## Keywords
AI assistant configuration, Embedded models, UI redesign, Sidebar navigation, Log viewer, Settings management
